aerial-a.defect: Wakes are extruded ribbons rather than V-shaped spreading foam.
aerial-a.fix: Replace ribbon wakes with a V-shaped foam mesh whose width and alpha grow with distance behind the hull.

aerial-a.defect: Main bridge deck floats with supports missing the water and the bridge type does not match the reference.
aerial-a.fix: Add piers every ~60 m reaching below the waterline and model the reference's low causeway with a central arched rise.

aerial-a.defect: Reflections absent from the whole water surface.
aerial-a.fix: Add planar or SSR cloud/sky reflection blended by fresnel.

aerial-a.defect: Wakes are line primitives, not spreading foam.
aerial-a.fix: Replace with a V-shaped decaying foam trail with turbulence texture.

aerial-a.defect: Uniform blob canopy far too dark and saturated.
aerial-a.fix: Mix 3-4 tree species incl. coconut palms, lighten albedo and enable canopy shadows.
Lower sky exposure, restore Rayleigh blue and add directional key light.

aerial-a.defect: Shadow casting absent for vegetation and structures.
aerial-a.fix: Enable cascaded shadow maps for trees and buildings.

aerial-a.defect: Specular response missing across water and aircraft.
aerial-a.fix: Add GGX sun highlight on water and aircraft materials.

aerial-a.defect: Grade is internally inconsistent (desaturated sky, oversaturated water).
aerial-a.fix: Apply a single filmic LUT and re-tune sky/water saturation toward the reference samples.

aerial-a.defect: Camera does not hold the aircraft and turn rate exceeds what the bank supports.
aerial-a.fix: Use a damped chase camera and couple turn rate to bank angle.
Randomise scale/rotation/species per instance and stagger pier spacing.

aerial-a.defect: HUD is frozen and reports stale values.
aerial-a.fix: Bind HUD text to the telemetry each frame.

bridge-low.defect: Reflections missing for large bright structures over calm water.
bridge-low.fix: Add planar reflection for the water plane.

bridge-low.defect: A 100 m white pylon and the deck stand directly over calm water with no reflection at all (flight.png A1-C8); the aircraft shadow is drawn but its reflection is absent.
bridge-low.fix: Add planar/SSR reflections for large structures and the aircraft.

bridge-low.defect: Missing reflections of large bright structures next to the water are a wrong-reflection hard failure.
bridge-low.fix: Enable planar reflections for the bridge.
Add transparent glass with interior and sky reflection.

bridge-low.defect: Water does not respond to most objects.
bridge-low.fix: Add contact foam at footings and hull wakes for all vessels.
Add species variety and canopy shading.
Vary container sizes/colours and use several car models.

bridge-low.defect: Wake is a straight uniform line; no bow wave.
bridge-low.fix: Add a V wake with foam.

bridge-low.defect: No sun glitter on the water, no highlight on the white pylon edges or wing.

bridge-low.fix: Add a foam ring at each tower base.

cloudy.defect: Reflections missing and sky reflection absent.
cloudy.fix: Add planar reflection and sky-colour Fresnel term.
Replace foam mask and raise shore mask resolution.
Remove contour banding and drive foam from wave crests.

cloudy.defect: Supports miss the water - hard failure.

cloudy.fix: Replace the tiled foam mask with a noise-driven whitecap function.

cloudy.defect: Wake is a uniform line and shallow foam draws as isolines.
cloudy.fix: Use V-wakes and break the contour foam into noise.
Use a layered stratus with base undulation and thin breaks.

cockpit-city.defect: Water interaction absent from the whole view.
cockpit-city.fix: Spawn boat traffic in the bay and add a foam line on the beach.
Add GGX highlights and glass reflection.

cockpit-city.defect: Detached plate above the wing is floating geometry and the strut is a stretched primitive.
cockpit-city.fix: Weld the plate to the wing, model a tubular strut and a rounded cowl.

cockpit-city.defect: Uniform roughness across the entire wing is a protocol hard failure.
cockpit-city.fix: Add a panel normal map, rivet lines and roughness variation to the wing underside.

cockpit-city.defect: Cowl and wing read as primitive boxes from the pilot seat.
cockpit-city.fix: Model a rounded cowl with fairing into the windscreen and add wing camber, root fairing and a fuel cap.
Add fairing geometry at the pillar-wing join and a normal map of rivet lines on the wing underside.

cockpit-city.defect: Uniform roughness/albedo across the whole wing.
cockpit-city.fix: Add paint micro-roughness variation, rivet normal map and a slightly glossier leading edge.

cockpit-city.defect: Blob trees with a single albedo.
cockpit-city.fix: Add palm and broadleaf species with albedo variation.

cockpit-city.defect: Infrastructure missing from a suburban coast.
cockpit-city.fix: Render the road network as a decal layer and add piers/marinas along the coast.
Enable shadow casting from the wing onto the cowl and panel.
Add boat traffic, road traffic and shore activity.

glass-sun.defect: Aircraft reflection missing on water and glass.
glass-sun.fix: Add planar water reflection and glass reflection.

glass-sun.defect: Floats float on the surface with no wake.
glass-sun.fix: Immerse floats to the waterline and emit a V-wake scaled by speed.

glass-sun.defect: Paper-thin stabiliser and floating black step slab.
glass-sun.fix: Extrude the stabiliser to an airfoil section, attach the step to the fuselage with brackets and replace the door rectangle with a handle mesh.

glass-sun.defect: Water reads as a flat tinted plane with blur streaks.
glass-sun.fix: Add a near-field wave normal map and depth-based colour.

glass-sun.defect: Pixelated edge and placeholder blocks at close range.
glass-sun.fix: Fix the cheatline mask resolution and replace placeholder blocks.

glass-sun.defect: Aircraft on calm water at 3 m distance with no reflection of floats, struts or fuselage.
No ripples or wet line at the float waterline.
Glass reads as absent under direct sun.
glass-sun.fix: Physically based glass with fresnel and sun highlight.

harbor.fix: Add planar reflection with distance fade.
Animate shore foam and add tugs and pilot boats with wakes.
Add GGX highlights on water and paint.

harbor.defect: The quay wall, warehouses and the white cruise ship stand at the water's edge with no reflection; the aircraft has none either.
Stray primitive is a placeholder artifact - hard failure.

harbor.fix: Use transmissive glass with a visible seat and panel.
Use palm and mangrove meshes with trunks.

harbor.defect: Cranes and quay infrastructure are placeholder frames.
harbor.fix: Model crane boom, trolley and portal, add quay rails and lane paint.

harbor.defect: Shadows missing for the largest objects.
harbor.fix: Enable shadow casting for terminal geometry and extend the shadow cascade.
Vary shed length and spacing and randomise crane and tree instances.

island-pass.fix: Add boat traffic and animated shore foam.
Fix the water shading term and decal UV.

island-pass.defect: Periodic wave banding across half the frame plus dithered foam noise.
island-pass.fix: Fix wave spectrum and foam mask.

island-pass.defect: Deep water reads as a flat banded blue plane - hard failure.
island-pass.fix: Dither the depth gradient and add wave normal detail to deep water.

island-pass.defect: Clone trees at regular spacing - hard failure.
island-pass.fix: Randomise palm species, scale and spacing.

night.defect: City light reflections absent at night.
night.fix: Add planar or screen-space reflection with emissive contribution.

night.defect: Dark glass with no interior light at night.
night.fix: Add emissive panel glow behind transmissive glass.
Add emissive bloom and roughness-based glitter.

night.defect: Clouds render fully daylit white (lum 148-186) against a 78-luminance night sky, as if the sun were up.
night.fix: Light clouds with the night sky/moon colour.

night.defect: Slowest airborne view by a factor of 4.2, pointing at the emissive-window pass.
night.fix: Batch window emissives into one instanced pass.
Clamp cloud radiance to moon irradiance and skip the night exposure multiplier for the sky/cloud pass.
Use a V-shaped wake with decay and scale foam brightness by sky luminance.
Light clouds from sky ambient and moon only and reduce albedo.
Disable cloud shadows when sun is below the horizon.

plane-front-quarter.defect: Aircraft reflection missing while on the water.
plane-front-quarter.fix: Add planar reflection for the water plane.

plane-front-quarter.defect: Floats float on the surface with no wake.
plane-front-quarter.fix: Immerse floats to the waterline and emit a V-wake scaled by speed.

plane-front-quarter.defect: Water reads as a flat tinted plane with blur streaks.
plane-front-quarter.fix: Add a near-field wave normal map and depth-based colour.

plane-front-quarter.defect: No reflection of the aircraft on the water it sits on; floats meet the surface with a glow halo only.
No ripples, wake or displacement at 5 kt; no wet line.

plane-front-quarter.fix: Add window grids and setbacks to the towers.

plane-front-quarter.defect: Flat strips of land with hard edges.
plane-front-quarter.fix: Add shoreline slope and shallow-water gradient.

plane-rear-quarter.defect: Aircraft reflection missing while on the water.
plane-rear-quarter.fix: Add planar reflection for the water plane.

plane-rear-quarter.defect: Floats float on the surface with a uniform foam halo and no wake.
plane-rear-quarter.fix: Immerse floats to the waterline and emit a V-wake with spray scaled by speed.

plane-rear-quarter.defect: Water reads as a flat tinted plane with blur streaks.
plane-rear-quarter.fix: Add a near-field wave normal map and depth-based colour.

plane-rear-quarter.defect: Evenly spaced clone boats and clone trees.
plane-rear-quarter.fix: Randomise boat types, spacing and tree meshes.

plane-rear-quarter.defect: Aircraft sitting on calm water at close range has no reflection whatsoever; the marina boats have none either.
No waterline, ripples, wake or displacement around floats that are taxiing at 5 kt; the halo reads as a glow.
plane-rear-quarter.fix: Add float wake, bow ripple and a wet waterline.

plane-rear-quarter.defect: Slowest view of the round despite a low triangle count, plus a 7.3 s hitch on the first clip frame: something in the marina/on-water state is very expensive.
plane-rear-quarter.fix: Profile the on-water shader path and precompile.

plane-rear-quarter.defect: Multi-second hitch when the water-contact effects first appear (hard-failure class: streaming stutter).
plane-rear-quarter.fix: Pre-compile effect programs at load with the emitters forced visible (renderer.compileAsync), and warm the wake/hull RTs during setup.

skyline-high.defect: Bridge supports miss the water - hard failure.
Straight map-boundary coastline visible in play; far land has no relief or land-use.
skyline-high.fix: Fade the height field to sea level with a noisy coastline over the last 1.5 km of the map (map.ts), or extend procedural land/ocean beyond HALF in terrain.ts.

skyline-high.defect: Flat texture plane to the horizon.
skyline-high.fix: Add heightfield relief, higher-resolution ground texture and block geometry.

skyline-high.defect: Wake is a single stroke and most vessels show no interaction.
skyline-high.fix: Add hull wakes and quay contact foam.
Restore a blue sky and directional key light.

skyline-high.defect: Camera loses the subject and turn rate exceeds bank.
skyline-high.fix: Chase camera and bank-coupled turn rate.

sunset.fix: Use a V-wake with decay and add pier foam.

sunset.defect: Wake is a laser-straight uniform line.

water-landing.fix: Render the distant skyline impostor above the horizon line.

water-landing.defect: Aircraft reflection missing over calm water.
water-landing.fix: Add planar reflection for the water plane.

water-landing.defect: Aircraft at 6 m over calm water casts a shadow but has no reflection; the sky is not reflected either.
water-landing.fix: Add planar reflection for the aircraft and sky.

water-landing.defect: Water reads as a flat cyan plane with a stretched texture - hard failure.
water-landing.fix: Depth colour plus a tiled wave normal map.

water-landing.defect: Ribbon wake and no float interaction.
Markers are simple poles without daymarks or lights.
water-landing.fix: Add daymark boards and a small dock on the island.
